title: Starboy and the Captain of Outer Space
description: Starboy and his brother, Captain of Outer Space, are faced with a big challenge where they fight historical figures who want to end the human race.
quote: Nobody can beat us, Starboy. Not even our forefathers. Or our foremothers.
